interface_detail: a Linux container with full root SSH access on a Debian, Ubuntu, AlmaLinux or Rocky template
tooling: any SSH client; the provider's client portal
chaining: a container sharing the host kernel with a routed /64 IPv6 subnet and no IPv4, so an IPv4-only peer cannot reach it unless the USD 24 a year address is added; no custom kernel modules and no port policy is stated
